3. Review all listed agencies to identify those designated as "Council on Aging" organizations
4. Download the associated population data (UZA Population or City Population columns)
5. Filter for cities with population >10,000
6. Order them from smallest to largest by 2020 population

Alternatively, you could access the open data portal at **https://data.transportation.gov** and download the raw NTD data files, then filter locally for:
- State = Louisiana
- Organization Type = Council on Aging (or similar designation)
- Report Year = 2020
- Population > 10,000

This is the only way to get the accurate, complete list ordered by population size that your question requires.
